title: planning/repos.yaml: the code repos a planning repo reads delivery from
description: Read tolerantly: unknown fields are allowed, so a newer nikOS can add to it. A version newer than 1 is refused before this schema runs.

version.description: The version of this file's format. nikOS reads 1.

repo.description: The repo's path on its host: owner/repo, or group/subgroup/project on GitLab.

host.description: The host, when it isn't github.com.

ref.description: A branch to read. Absent means the repo's default branch.

url.description: The git url to read from, when it isn't derived from host and repo.
